Barkley, Shut Up and Jam: Gaiden

Chapter 1 of the Hoopz Barkley SaGa — Tales of Game's (2008),
ported to modern GameMaker and playable right here.

▶ PLAY IN BROWSER

or download it for your OS — macOS, Windows, or Linux, rebuilt from every update.

Controls

Arrow keysmove / navigate menus
Zaction / confirm
Xcancel / back
Cmenu / start

All keys are rebindable in the in-game settings. Controllers are supported too — freshly wired, so tell us if your pad misbehaves.

New in this port

  • A tunable CRT filter — the headline feature. Head to Configuration → FILTER and open the TUNE CRT FILTER screen: pick Off, Arcade, or Dosbox CRT (a faithful port of Mattias Gustavsson's beloved dosbox-crt) and dial in warp, scanlines, shadows, grain and ghosting live, with character portraits and colour bars to judge by. Seriously, go try it.
  • Realistic voice acting — every line Charles Barkley delivers now carries the gravitas of his real voice, in the sense that the dialogue bloops (think Undertale) are pitched from analysis of actual interview footage. Hoopz speaks in certified 1990 Fresh Prince register. Togglable in the settings, obviously.
  • Fit-window and strict integer scaling, freely resizable window, native fullscreen.
  • Native builds for macOS (Apple Silicon + Intel), Windows 10+, and Linux (x64/arm64) on the releases page.
  • The 2014 "Vinceborg laser" crash fix (of AGDQ fame) and dozens of engine-compatibility repairs, with the original 2008 game logic preserved.

Game by Tales of Game's, released under CC BY-NC 4.0 — free forever, never for sale.
